items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Time in AZ done; trade expected after Sunday games. Houston among teams in mix.
items.why: Trade imminent; team comfortable making inactive
items.implication: No Week 5 production; ROS depends on new team
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson elevated role/targets in ARI

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) ruled OUT for SNF vs ATL; Tyler Huntley to start.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game downgraded
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers/Likely/Henry still viable but lower ceiling

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) OUT for Week 5 London game vs JAX along with DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown.
items.implication: Eagles backfield to Shipley/Pierce; offense limited
items.opportunity: Will Shipley lead back RB2 upside; Hurts rushing

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + soft run D; nickname push 'Brown Gobbler'.
items.why: Targets + carries gobbled; Bengals injuries help

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) OUT Week 5 vs JAX.
Jayden Daniels (elbow) IN/expected to play/start vs NYG; full participant, brace on non-throwing arm.
Stefon Diggs (hamstring) OUT Week 5 vs NYG.
items.implication: WAS WR targets to McLaurin/others if playing
items.opportunity: Terry McLaurin or backups elevated if also limited

items.text: Chargers WR Quentin Johnston (chest) OUT Week 5 vs DEN.
Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (ankle maintenance); projects 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier. Expect much better role/workload after Week 4 criticism despite long-year risk.
items.why: Full go comments; not on report; media pressure on usage

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume/red-zone hog vs weak Titans pass D.
Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume including RZ vs Lions.
items.why: Target hog + matchup; boosted by MHJ absence

items.text: Chris Olave removed from injury report/IN for Week 5.

Malik Nabers multi-risk long-term: knee issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, boomer coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman). Frustration over late-game targets noted; no designation this week.
items.implication: Monitor closely ROS; still playable short-term

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison @ NO as WR41; tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle.
